call_points.text: FY27 revenue growth guidance of 18-20% reiterated despite the Q1 miss.
EBITDA margin guidance of 21-24% held; Q1 came in at 23.5%.
Orders from one US space customer exceed ₹1,000 Cr, delivered by end of FY28.
Kandla plant targeted to start operations by December-end or mid-January; civil work and long-lead machines ordered.
Savli cryo and keg shops are in full production; keg utilisation guided from 30% to 50-60% by year-end.
Total fund availability of ₹331 Cr as of 30 June 2026 supports Kandla and other growth plans.
US market entry blocked until 2028 by a non-compete agreement; groundwork started.
LNG and Cryo-Scientific orders delayed by customer and regulatory approvals; management expects conversion in one or two quarters.
Container freight to Europe rose from $3,000-4,000 to $8,000-9,000, prompting customers to defer deliveries.
Transformer tank business may be discontinued as carbon steel fabrication does not fit manufacturing capabilities.
Order book stood at ₹1,514 crores as of March 31, 2026, with 63% from exports and 37% from domestic markets.
Developing a new facility at Kandla on 7 acres of land, expected to be commissioned within 9 to 10 months to manufacture ultra-large tanks.

timeline.summary: Shreyasi Goenka, as Promoter Group member, declared no encumbrance on INOX India shares for FY2026 under SEBI’s Regulation 31(4).
Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹460.65 Cr (+24.7% YoY), net profit ₹75.24 Cr (+14.9% YoY).
INOX India reported Q4FY26 revenue of ₹475 Cr and FY26 revenue of ₹1,632 Cr, recommending a dividend of ₹2 per share.
INOX India Limited shared the audio recording of its Q4FY26 earnings conference call with analysts and investors held on May 13, 2026, signed by **Jaymeen Mohanbhai Patel**, Corporate Relations Head.
Lata Rungta, as Promoter Group member, declared no share purchase by her or persons acting in concert for INOX India Limited during FY ended March 31, 2026.
INOX India reported Q4FY26 total income of ₹475 Cr and FY26 revenue of ₹1,632 Cr, with an order book of ₹1,514 Cr.
INOX India disclosed an insider trading report where promoter group member Lata Madhusudan Rungta sold 10,000 shares for ₹1.43 Cr.
INOX India secured multiple orders worth ₹322 Cr since April 2026.
Promoter group member Lata Madhusudan Rungta sold 21,000 shares representing 0.023% of the company on May 20, 2026.
INOX India Limited invites analysts to Q2FY27 results conference call on 4 November 2026 at 11:00 am IST.
